To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an algorithm, called MSC, that integrates gene expression data and literature information for gene clustering and that the clusters obtained by MSC are more biologically meaningful than those obtained using gene expression data.

(i) algorithm MSC can improve the results obtained using gene expression data when the information from biomedical text literature is used to bootstrap the model, and (ii) the clusters obtained using MSC can be used to identify motifs that are biologically meaningful.
we have developed a new clustering method that can use gene expression data and biomedical text data together to identify biologically relevant clusters of genes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel algorithm to cluster genes using gene expression data and biomedical text literature.
the problem of integrating multiple sources of information to improve the clustering results.
developing an effective and efficient clustering algorithm that can integrate diverse types of data sources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integration of gene expression data with text literature data can lead to more biologically relevant gene clusters.
MSC is a novel and effective clustering method for integrating multiple data sources.
the integration of the gene expression and text data improves the clustering of gene expression data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our algorithm MSC, when used to integrate gene expression data with text literature data, is able to identify more biologically meaningful clusters than those identified by clustering the gene expression data alone.
the clusters identified using algorithm MSC are more biologically meaningful than those identified by using either gene expression or text data alone.

our algorithm MSC provides a new way for integrating two different data sources for clustering and that the clusters identified using the two data sources together are biologically more relevant than the clusters identified using either of the data sources separately.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the clustering of gene expression data using the information extracted from the biomedical literature can improve the quality of the clusters.
the use of multiple sources of data for clustering improves the results of the analysis.
by integrating multiple data sources, one can obtain more accurate and more biologically relevant clusters than those obtained using a single data source.
